text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the removal of an on-street accessible parking space located on the south side of Rolland Road, west of Hanna Road. The existing on-street accessible parking space is no longer required by the original applicant.

North York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing on-street accessible parking space on the south side of Rolland Road, between a point 30 metres west of Hanna Road and a point 5.5 metres further west.
